title: Constructibility over a quotient ring from finite constant quotient labels
statement:
Let $T$ be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, let $I\subseteq A$ be an ideal, and put $B=A/I$. On the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] use constant ring sheaves $A_T,B_T$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $F$ be a sheaf of $B_T$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] whose restriction of scalars to $A_T$ [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars] is intrinsically constructible [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]. Then $F$ is intrinsically constructible as a $B_T$-module sheaf.

More precisely, take any witnessing finite constructible locally closed stratification of the underlying $A_T$-module sheaf, and any trivializing pro-etale covering on its strata with finite constant $A$-module labels $M$ [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf]. The same strata and covers trivialize $F$ as a $B_T$-module sheaf with finite labels $M/IM$: on each such localized covering member there is a $B$-linear isomorphism $F|_U\cong\underline{M/IM}_U$. This includes empty strata and covering members and does not assert $IM=0$ for an arbitrary label on an empty member. No hypothesis on Tor amplitude or complexes is imposed.

proof.text: For every scheme map f and coefficient quotient q:A→A/I, prove the square between f⁻¹(q), c_A and c_(A/I) by transposing to direct image and then to the constant presheaf. It is the naturality equation for the ring sheafification unit. Scalar extension along c_A and c_(A/I) is restriction along their inverses, by the extension/restriction adjunction and uniqueness of left adjoints in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Compose this with the scalarIdentification isomorphism of [lem-pur-proetale-inverse-image-tensor-comparison]. Identity on sections, linear by the coefficient square, identifies the resulting two restricted actions. This gives pullbackRestrictIso: f_A^*(Res F) ≅ Res(f_(A/I)^* F). No immersion or finiteness hypothesis is required for this comparison.

On a localized member U, let G be an A/I-module sheaf and e:Res(G)|_U ≅ constant(M). Transpose e inverse through the module-sheafification unit from [lem-cbc-sieve-module-sheafification], giving k:M→G(V) at every slice object V. Naturality of the ring unit with q gives k(am)=q(a)k(m). The additive map k kills I times the top submodule by Submodule.smul_induction_on: each generator a m with a∈I maps to zero, and sums map to sums. Descend k to t:M/IM→G(V) using QuotientAddGroup.lift. Lifting scalars through the surjection A→A/I and vectors through M→M/IM verifies A/I-linearity; naturality is checked on vector lifts. This constructs a morphism g from the constant quotient-module presheaf to the restricted presheaf of G, over the restricted constant ring, exactly as defined in [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf].

Write c for the constant additive presheaf map M→M/IM. It is pointwise surjective, hence locally surjective, and c followed by the underlying g equals the underlying k. The latter is the sheafification unit followed by an isomorphism, so it is locally bijective. Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_of_isLocallyInjective_of_isLocallySurjective_fac and Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_of_isLocallySurjective_fac now make g locally bijective. Transpose g by [lem-cbc-sieve-module-sheafification]. On underlying abelian sheaves the transpose is sheafification(g) followed by the sheafification counit; both are invertible. Reflection of isomorphisms by SheafOfModules.toSheaf makes the transpose an A/I-linear isomorphism. This replaces the planned exact-sequence calculation by local bijectivity and directly uses the restricted coefficient ring on the slice, so no independent localized-ring comparison is needed. Empty members are covered by the same argument; IM is never asserted to be zero as an abstract module.

Unpack the constructibility witness [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf] and retain its exact stratification, positive number of strata, and each trivializing cover. On each stratum compose each given chart with pullbackRestrictIso restricted to that member, then apply the quotient chart of steps 2–3, choosing label M/IM. This proves local constancy over A/I. Apply the stalk functor [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk] to pullbackRestrictIso to transfer finite stalks. Scalar restriction leaves the underlying additive stalk colimit definitionally unchanged, so these are the finite stalks of the A/I-pullback. Assemble the original stratification as the constructibility witness. For the specified-chart clause apply exactly the same construction to every supplied member; quotientLabelFinite follows from finiteness of a quotient of the finite underlying set M. This clause needs none of the supplied stalk, cover or positivity hypotheses, but keeps the exact original signature.

It adds no new nodes and leaves the statement unchanged. Sources checked: Stacks sites-modules 093J (l.8198), 093I, 093Q and 03D2, plus the master text of thm-exc-explicit-preservation (proof paragraph 2) and the citer's step 5. Step 1 is correct: c_A and c_B are isomorphisms by lem-pur-proetale-constant-coefficient-comparison (unit sk-def-sf-operations, which the unit cites), and the square with q holds by sheafification uniqueness and the adjunction, so i_A^*Res F = Res i_B^*F. Step 3 is correct: alpha(eta(sum a_k m_k)) = sum q(a_k)alpha(eta m_k) = 0, so the sheaf of IM vanishes; the module IM is not claimed to be zero. Steps 4-5 are correct but had one missing citation (C4). The cited exactness lemma and the cbc adjunction are about modules over the localized site's own constant ring sheaf, while the charts are over the restricted rings A_S|_U and B_S|_U, and the identification was used without a citation. The fix cites the Mathlib leaf lem-pur-ring-presheaf-sheafification-localization in steps 4 and 5 and recomputes proof_deps. Step 6 is correct: restriction of scalars leaves the stalk colimits unchanged and finite, B is finite, the partition is kept, M/IM is finite, and the empty-member remark holds. Small cases checked: I=0, I=A (B=0), Z/4->Z/2, an empty member with IM nonzero, T empty. Not duplicates: lem-weil-pbc-constructible-change-of-ring (etale site), lem-pe-finite-scalar-restriction-constructible (forward direction, Noetherian X). tool_uses: lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-constant-exact is accepted as a generic constant-sheaf exactness tool; the comparison lemma is on route anyway.
